message.content: I have what I need. Apple's FY2024 results (verified against both the newsroom release and the 10-K) show record Q4 revenue and a return to growth. Placing the order now.
message.reasoning_content:
I have enough. Key figures verified from primary sources:
- FY2024 net sales $391,035M ($391.0B), up from $383,285M
- FY2024 net income $93,736M (~$93.7B), down slightly from $96,995M due to one-time $10.2B tax charge
- FY2024 diluted EPS $6.08 (vs $6.13)
- FY2024 operating income $123,216M
- Q4 revenue $94.9B, up 6% YoY
- Stock ~$222.70, little changed; concerns about iPhone 16 demand

Decision: buy. Fundamentals: record Q4 revenue growth 6%, strong operating income, services growth, Apple Intelligence rollout as catalyst, valuation reasonable at ~36.6x trailing EPS. Concerns: flat iPhone demand, China competition, EPS slightly declined due to tax charge.

Order sizing: max $10,000 per order. At limit ~$222.90, quantity = 44 shares → 44 × 222.90 = $9,807.60. That's under $10,000. Good.

Limit price close to market: ask 222.72, last 222.70. Set limit $222.90 (slightly above ask, so fills but still "close"). Or $223.00 → 44 × 223 = $9,812. Let's use 222.90.

Key figures for the order: revenue FY2024 391,035 USD millions; net_income 93,736 USD millions; eps_diluted 6.08 USD/share; operating_income 123,216 USD millions.

Note: I don't have operating_cash_flow verified, so don't include it (that would be fabricating). Only include figures I verified.

Place order.
